name: Example collection
description: Replace this with a real curated set. Each item just needs a title and a url; everything else is optional and shown as metadata.
note: Images must be served with CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin) or they will not load — the clipper reads pixels off the canvas. IIIF endpoints usually work; ordinary web pages usually do not.

items.title: Placeholder — add your own
items.notes: url is the full-resolution image. thumb is optional; the full url is used if omitted. tags drive the filter chips and are per-collection.
